name: @xiguazhiprince/dsh-session-map
description: Session map, BTW forks, skills and AGENTS.md panels, a Conversation → MCP manager for native dsh-mcp-client rows, an IntelliJ-style Git tool window, quote-to-chat from file previews, and a GitHub-style usage heat map for DeepSeek Harness: draw each session's turn-fork tree, fork the running session at its exact progress into a read-only copy, see the skills and instruction files a session really uses, manage profile MCP servers (stdio / HTTP, OAuth, import/export, diagnose), quote a right-sidebar file selection (absolute path + line range + source excerpt) into the composer, chart AI line edits, tokens, turns and agent time from local session logs, and stage, commit, push, update or clone a repository without leaving the GUI.
